Dylan / Sarah — quick clarifications from Compliance side: 
- Bridge letter: we do provide a concise bridge letter for customers that confirms the audit scope, the report period (we will reference 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30), and a statement on whether any control changes occurred after the period that materially affect the conclusions. It is not a substitute for a full report but helps close the gap.
- Redaction / evidence: We do not include evidence in the report share; if FinClient requests specific artifacts (e.g., access logs), that is a separate evidence exchange under a tightly scoped request and may require additional approvals and MPC/legal consent.
- Turnaround: standard NDA review + bridge letter prep is typically 3-5 business days; secure delivery set-up and final approval may bring us to 7 business days in edge cases.

If you want the 7-business-day SLA, please ensure the NDA is returned with any redlines within 48 hours and complete the access form fully.

Thanks,
